project_type: Python uv workspace (FastAPI services, Kafka/Neo4j/Postgres/Redis) + standalone React 18/Vite/TS SPA in ui/ (not in the uv workspace)
build_system: ui: npm ci + `tsc -b && vite build` (ui/package.json, committed package-lock.json, Dockerfile runs npm ci && npm run build; nginx :8090). Backend: uv workspace. Zero new npm dependencies are planned so the lockfile must not change.
test_framework: ui: Vitest 2.1.5 + React Testing Library 16 + jest-dom + user-event (jsdom, globals, setup ui/vitest.setup.ts). Backend: pytest.
test_command: cd ui && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build ; backend: uv run pytest libs/acip-common services/checkout-api services/graph-projector -q && uv run ruff check libs/acip-common ml scripts
verification_instructions: Read /Users/rahulurane/Documents/git_repo/agentic-commerce-intelligence-platform/.agents/tasks/ui-redesign-plan.md (sections 0-12) FIRST; it contains verbatim copy, tokens, state matrix and test plan. snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. ui/dist, ui/*.tsbuildinfo, vite.config.js/.d.ts are build artefacts: check `git ls-files ui` and never stage untracked ones. Screenshots go to .agents/tasks/ui-screenshots/ (never commit; never stage .agents/).

Do not change start.sh/start-local.sh behaviour, Dockerfile, nginx.conf, vite.config.ts or VITE_CHECKOUT_API_URL handling. Stay on branch feat/phase1-foundation; commit locally; never push. Do not adopt Vega; do not draw/fabricate the company logo.
contribution_requirements: Thin client: no decision logic in the frontend. Honesty: no fabricated timings/scores/rationale. Light theme default; dark toggle persisted in localStorage (acip.theme); tour flag acip.tour.done. All brand colours only in ui/src/styles/brand.css. Thresholds only in ui/src/config/thresholds.ts. AA contrast both themes; status never colour-only.
key_patterns: Existing code: api/client.ts (ApiError, pollTransaction tolerant of 404/empty), scenarios.ts scenarioBody() mirrors scripts/demo.py exactly (keep payload unchanged), decision.ts maps decisions to classes, components under ui/src/components, tests under ui/src/__tests__ using vi.stubGlobal('fetch'). Backend reads via ReadModel protocol in checkout-api/reads.py with fake store in tests; projector uses a fake cursor matching 'INSERT INTO agent_verdicts' in tests.
directory_structure: ui/ (Vite SPA: src/{api,components,__tests__}, Dockerfile, nginx.conf); services/<name>/{src,tests}; libs/acip-common; scripts/{seed,demo}.py; docs/*.md; .agents/tasks/ (plans, not committed).
